description: Hello, We are the team "Orbit Overlords" ready to win the challenge. We are gonna push to our limits and and claim the crown. let the games begin!
summary: We used official NASA and NASA allied space organizations data to make an illustrative and interactive website that is aimed at compiling all of this information together, this is the 25th version after much developtment. And we made sure that all of the information that was before much harder to access and understand is now much much easier to understand and access, this is our main target and goal. Even though there are some glitches it is very functionable and customizable.
details: Our project is coded in HTML and uses Chart.js and Tailwind.js to make interactive 3D models and interactive charts, the benefits of this project is that information is now more accessible and easier to understand and the impact we hope to achieve is that aspiring students will use this website to learn and understand how to pursue their career paths and for teachers to use it as a teaching tool. Our project is creative in it's graphs and 3D models and information on Re-entry shields and other materials. We considered interactivity and the information we had to add here and we decided to create a website that is visually appealing and is easy to understand due to the illustrations and the AI. And to make it a public link we had to upload it to Netlify.
